default_roles.reviewer_custodian: Claude or explicitly assigned separate existing reviewer

tasks.title: Pin reusable interfaces and actual ownership
tasks.instruction: Two focused searches; identify one next implementation seam, preserve active studies.

tasks.title: Bind quantity, status, authority and execution profile
tasks.instruction: Reuse native schema; define one operational flow unit and one executable board subset.

tasks.title: Wrap exact Ohm and independent execution telemetry
tasks.instruction: No duplicated numeric semantics or calculated observations.

tasks.title: Connect one bounded real actuator
tasks.instruction: Allocation must change actual work; baseline gets same API.

tasks.title: Join readiness, RPM frames and commit coordinator
tasks.instruction: Reuse current tick order, method qualification and exact parent return.

tasks.title: Execute the bounded native board-to-board witness
tasks.instruction: Known missing-method witness plus wrong-method, budget and actuator-off controls.

tasks.title: Project actual trace into existing RPA and restart
tasks.instruction: No live authority from navigation; no fake coordinate values.

tasks.title: Summarize saved public Q4 errors and choose one task
tasks.instruction: No model rerun merely to read existing errors; separate assisted and free generation.

tasks.title: Bind frozen learned model to a typed CJT path
tasks.instruction: Strict reading and hybrid structured processing have separate contracts.

tasks.title: Fix matched pilot design and resource manifests
tasks.instruction: 24 task groups by default; fixed/generic-adaptive/CAS; all costs counted.

tasks.title: Run focused instruments and bounded pilot
tasks.instruction: No active Helm preemption; all conditions, failures and source identities retained.

tasks.title: Publish result and close the lane
tasks.instruction: Report actual comparisons, limits and next single improvement; no version promotion.
